items.source: By default, IVF_FLAT requires nprobe to be set for accurate results. If not specified, nprobe defaults to 1, which can lead to poor recall or even zero search results.

items.source: Milvus is an open-source vector database that has garnered significant attention in the fields of data science and machine learning. One of its standout features lies in its robust support for vector indexing and querying. Milvus employs state-of-the-art, cutting-edge algorithms to accelerate the search process, making it exceptionally efficient at retrieving similar vectors, even when handling extensive datasets.
items.translation: Milvus 是一个开源向量数据库，在数据科学和机器学习领域获得了极高的关注。其显著特征之一在于对向量索引和查询的强大支持。Milvus 采用最先进的尖端算法来加速搜索过程，使其在处理大规模数据集时，能够极其高效地检索相似向量。

items.source: You can use the following properties in your Spring Boot configuration to customize the Milvus vector store.

items.source: The name of the Milvus database to use.

items.source: The metric type to be used for the Milvus collection.
items.translation: 用于 Milvus 集合的度量类型。

items.source: The index parameters to be used for the Milvus collection.

items.source: Connection timeout value of client channel. The timeout value must be greater than zero .

items.source: Keep-alive time value of client channel. The keep-alive value must be greater than zero.
items.translation: 客户端通道的保活时间值。保活值必须大于零。

items.translation: 客户端通道的保活超时值。超时值必须大于零。

items.source: Deadline for how long you are willing to wait for a reply from the server. With a deadline setting, the client will wait when encounter fast RPC fail caused by network fluctuations. The deadline value must be larger than or equal to zero.

items.source: The client.pem path for tls two-way authentication, only takes effect when "secure" is true
